name: DotGrid-TS-TW
title: Dot Grid
blurb: Grid of interactive dots with color gradient proximity and click-triggered…
description: Canvas-rendered dot grid using gsap for inertia-based animation. Dots respond to mouse proximity with color interpolation and to clicks with radial shock waves. Supports elastic return animation.
use_when: Interactive backgrounds where a playful, physics-based response to user input creates engagement.
avoid_when: Touch-only surfaces or when static backgrounds are required; relies on mouse events.
a11y: Mouse and click interactive; no keyboard control. No prefers-reduced-motion guard. Canvas is not semantically accessible.
